_comment: Template for the IAM identity archive-compaction uses. __BUCKET_NAME__ is resolved by archive-compaction on every run against its own s3.bucket config and written to {data_dir}/aws-setup/iam-policy.json -- paste that resolved file directly into the console's JSON policy editor (see docs/aws-setup.md). Deliberately its own identity, not shared with archive-processor's -- it needs Delete and bucket-level List that archive-processor doesn't, and no access to flights/* content at all (it only lists flights/* keys for the parity check, never reads them).
